verdict: Organic presence is carrying all activity; paid channels remain off.
narrative: This period, your business ran entirely on organic local presence — paid advertising was inactive across all channels, producing no spend and no paid leads. Your Google Business Profile delivered 42 actions over the 28 days, but that activity has dropped sharply in the most recent week, down 94% compared to the week prior, with the last few days showing near-zero engagement. Website sessions held at 212 for the period, including a one-day spike on September 1st that did not continue, and no site visits are currently converting to intake inquiries. Reactivating paid campaigns is the immediate priority to restore a reliable lead flow and reduce dependence on organic activity alone.

highlights.phrase: Google Business Profile actions this period — calls, direction requests, and site clicks — all from organic local search
drop in Google Business Profile engagement over the last 7 days compared to the prior 7
website sessions this period, none of which converted to a captured intake inquiry

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement has collapsed to near zero in the last three days, and no paid campaigns are active to compensate.
watch_item.fix: Paid campaign reactivation is the immediate next step to restore consistent lead flow while organic visibility is investigated.
